name: PRISM
aliases: Precise and Rapid Interaction through Scaled Manipulation
summary: Adjusts control-display gain according to hand movement speed to support precise selection and manipulation in immersive environments.
howItWorks: When the hand moves slowly, its motion is scaled down so the ray or object moves less than the hand, allowing precise selection. Fast movements map one-to-one, and the offset is recovered over time.
